What can you do on this tab?
See each product’s donation type, shortcode, and the amount raised on goal campaigns at a glance.
Click “Edit” to change settings; the “Donation” tab on the product edit screen opens and is saved with the product.
The button shortcode opens a centered popup, the side panel shortcode opens a panel from the right, and the form shortcode shows an inline form.
